scope: single-A100 synthetic TP8 per-rank FusedMoE; not a chain or service score
derivation: Select named JSON record kinds from raw; timing summaries are copied verbatim from the SHA-identified benchmark and reproducible from timing_round records.
notes: CUDA graph pools are independent; all-arm resident memory is not a per-arm saving.
W13 StreamK removal changes BF16 partial-output rounding; no full-layer bitwise-equivalence claim.
Independent checkpoint FP32 and fresh graph/eager numerical gates passed; actual baseline-W13 W2 inputs and reduction raw BF16 bits matched.
Only one input seed and synthetic checkpoint; confirm real weights/TP8 and chain before adoption.
D and E ran concurrently on separate GPUs; compare arms within a case, not between GPUs.
SM clocks varied 1290-1395MHz in timing telemetry; no claim of fixed clocks.
